name: CoreWeave, Inc.

profile.description: CoreWeave operates a purpose-built GPU cloud for AI workloads serving nine of the 10 leading foundation model providers. Q2 2026 revenue was $2.58B (+112% YoY) with $104B revenue backlog.

innovation.label: STRONG
innovation.analysis: Track Record (3/3): CoreWeave pivoted from crypto mining into the leading AI-specialized cloud, now serving nine of the top 10 foundation model providers [1][2]. AI Deployment (2/2): AI cloud is the product, generating $2.58B Q2 revenue. Market Share (2/2): The leading neocloud by scale, with $104B backlog up 246% YoY [1]. Pipeline (1/2): Q3 guide of $3.4-3.6B and $25B+ new commitments, but specific product timelines are generic. R&D Intensity (0/1): Capital-heavy with limited R&D relative to peers.

inspiration.label: WEAK
inspiration.analysis: Mission Floor (2/4): 'The Essential Cloud for AI' is clear but commercially framed. Community (0/2): No community program evidence found. Employee Retention (0/2): Glassdoor culture 2.9/5 with reports of 60-80 hour weeks and fear-based management [2]. Insider Buying (0/2): No net insider buying evidence; post-IPO selling is the pattern.

infrastructure.label: DEVELOPING
infrastructure.analysis: Growth sleeve, mechanical. D/E 1027% (0.0), ROE -43.6% (0.0, 2x), revenue growth 112% (1.0), 5yr CAGR far above 10% (1.0, 2x), forward P/E negative and scored 0, profit margin -25.4% (0.0); PEG unavailable and excluded. Weighted 3.0 of 8 gives 4. Daily dollar volume of about $2.5B clears the liquidity floor [1].

ai_resilience.label: LOW RISK
ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk Protection (8/9): CoreWeave is AI infrastructure, so AI adoption drives demand rather than substituting for it; backlog is $104B [1]. Concentration in a few AI labs and circular-financing criticism are counterparty risks, not disruption [2]. AI Opportunity (1/1): The entire $2.58B quarterly revenue is AI cloud.

infinite_game.summary: CoreWeave reinvented itself from crypto mining to AI infrastructure with bold debt-funded capacity bets, but its cause is commercial, culture is described as fear-based, and the strategy is growth-at-speed.

just_cause.analysis: Just Cause (1/3): The AI-cloud mission is a business position rather than a future-state cause [2].

trusting_teams.analysis: Trusting Teams (0/2): Glassdoor describes unrealistic deadlines, long hours and little leadership loyalty [2].

worthy_rivals.analysis: Worthy Rivals (0/1): The CEO frames survival as speed and focus in a hyper-competitive market, with little learning-from-rivals language [2].

existential_flexibility.analysis: Existential Flexibility (2/2): Abandoned Ethereum mining for AI cloud, a transformative pivot [2].

courage_to_lead.analysis: Courage to Lead (1/2): Committed to massive GPU and data-center capex with 1027% D/E ahead of proven profits [1].

investment_thesis: CoreWeave is the scale leader in AI cloud: Q2 2026 revenue of $2.58B grew 112% with 59% adjusted EBITDA margin, backlog reached $104B, and 2026 guidance is $12.4-13.2B revenue [1]. Nine of the top 10 foundation model providers are customers, and Q3 guidance implies ~158% growth.
thesis_continued: The bear case is leverage and quality of earnings: D/E is 1027%, ROE is -43.6%, profit margin is -25.4%, and the backlog equals roughly 40 quarters of revenue, so delivery and financing are critical [1]. Customer concentration and circular-deal criticism, power and water ESG exposure, and a 2.9/5 culture rating add risk [2][3].
key_catalysts: Converting $104B backlog and $25B+ new Q3 commitments into revenue; Q3 guide of $3.4-3.6B [1]
Adjusted operating income of $960M-$1.15B guided for 2026 as scale improves margins [1]
Continued demand from nine of the top 10 foundation model providers [2]
key_risks: 1027% D/E and heavy GPU capex financing; negative profit margin of -25.4% [1]
Customer concentration and circular AI-deal scrutiny [2]
Energy, water and critical-mineral ESG exposure plus new climate disclosure rules [3]

backlog.note: $104B backlog at Q2 2026 (+246% YoY), excluding $25B+ of new commitments in early Q3; the 40x quarterly-revenue ratio signals significant capacity and execution risk. Funded share and TTM book-to-bill not disclosed.

sources: CoreWeave Q1 and Q2 2026 earnings, CNBC and Investing.com, May-August 2026
CoreWeave leadership and culture: Columbia Business School interview, TechCrunch (Dec 2025), Glassdoor, 2025-2026
CoreWeave Form 10-Q (June 30, 2026) risk factors, SEC EDGAR
